# Third-party writing assets

`hanzi-writer.min.js` is the unchanged browser build from [Hanzi Writer 3.5.0](https://www.npmjs.com/package/hanzi-writer/v/3.5.0).
The [MIT license](LICENSE.hanzi-writer.txt) is copied from its official npm package.

`lesson-characters.json` contains the 47 unique characters from the [P6 Lesson 1 Tingxie list](../../content/p6/tingxie/1.yaml).
On 2026-11-20, these records were selected from [Hanzi Writer Data 2.0.1](https://www.npmjs.com/package/hanzi-writer-data/v/2.0.1) and grouped by character without changing their stroke data.
The character data derives from Make Me a Hanzi and is distributed under the included [Arphic Public License](ARPHICPL.TXT).

[Moonbridge Run's character data](../../moonbridge/stroke-data.json) uses the same dataset and license for the 45 unique characters in the [P3 Lesson 1 Tingxie list](../../content/p3/tingxie/1.yaml). The stroke records are unchanged.

[Fog Harbour's character data](../../fogharbour/stroke-data.json) uses the same dataset and license for all 42 unique characters in the [P6 Lesson 2 Tingxie list](../../content/p6/tingxie/2.yaml). The stroke records are unchanged.
